set: AZ-900: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals practice – Cloud Essentials

questions.stem: A company deploys Windows Server virtual machines by using Azure Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS). Under the shared responsibility model, which task is the company's responsibility?
options: Installing security updates for the guest operating system
Maintaining the physical servers in Azure datacenters
Replacing failed physical storage devices in the datacenter
questions.explanation: In an IaaS deployment, the customer is responsible for managing and patching the guest operating system, applications, and configurations. Microsoft manages the underlying physical infrastructure, including servers, storage hardware, and physical networking. The division of responsibilities depends on the cloud service model.
questions.subtopic: Describe cloud computing
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe cloud computing — Shared responsibility model

questions.stem: A financial services company operates some applications in its own datacenter while running other applications in Microsoft Azure. The two environments are connected and used together. Which cloud deployment model does this represent?
questions.explanation: A hybrid cloud combines private infrastructure, such as an organization's on-premises datacenter, with public cloud services. This model enables organizations to retain selected workloads on-premises while using Azure for other workloads. Multicloud specifically involves using services from more than one cloud provider.
questions.subtopic: Describe cloud computing
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe cloud computing — Public, private, and hybrid cloud models

questions.stem: An online retailer experiences large fluctuations in website traffic throughout the day. Which TWO actions demonstrate cloud elasticity? Choose TWO.
options: Encrypting stored customer data to protect confidentiality
Automatically adding compute instances when traffic increases
Applying resource locks to prevent accidental deletion
Automatically removing compute instances when traffic decreases
questions.explanation: Elasticity enables cloud resources to expand and contract dynamically in response to workload demand. Adding instances during peak traffic and removing them when demand falls are both examples of elasticity. Encryption and resource locks are security and governance controls rather than elasticity features.
questions.subtopic: Describe the benefits of using cloud services
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe the benefits of using cloud services — Scalability

questions.stem: A company subscribes to Microsoft 365 so employees can use hosted email and collaboration applications. Microsoft manages the applications and their underlying infrastructure. Which cloud service model best describes this arrangement?
questions.explanation: SaaS provides complete applications to customers without requiring them to manage the application infrastructure. Microsoft 365 is a common example because Microsoft operates and maintains the hosted applications. Customers primarily manage their users, data, and relevant application settings.
questions.subtopic: Describe cloud service types
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe cloud service types — SaaS

questions.stem: A development team needs to process messages that arrive unpredictably throughout the day. The team wants to execute code when messages arrive without provisioning servers and pay primarily for actual execution. Which Azure solution best meets these requirements?
options: Azure Virtual Machines with reserved instances
Azure Kubernetes Service with continuously running nodes
Azure Dedicated Host with dedicated physical servers
Azure Functions on the Consumption plan
questions.explanation: Azure Functions supports event-driven execution without requiring developers to provision or manage servers. On the Consumption plan, compute resources scale automatically, and billing is based on executions and resource consumption, subject to the plan's billing rules. This makes it suitable for intermittent workloads with unpredictable demand.
questions.subtopic: Describe cloud computing
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe cloud computing — Serverless

questions.stem: An organization manages eight Azure subscriptions belonging to different departments. Its administrators want to assign one Azure Policy at a scope above all eight subscriptions so that the policy applies across them. Which Azure component should they use?
questions.explanation: Azure management groups provide a governance scope above subscriptions. Policy assignments and access controls applied at a management group can be inherited by its child subscriptions. This allows organizations to manage multiple subscriptions consistently without assigning the same policy separately to each one.
questions.subtopic: Describe the core architectural components of Azure
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe the core architectural components of Azure — Management groups

questions.stem: A company wants to protect an application against the failure of a single datacenter while keeping its application resources within one Azure region. Which description correctly identifies Azure availability zones?
options: Separate geographic regions connected through Microsoft's global network
Logical resource containers used to manage related Azure services
Physically separate datacenter groups with independent power, cooling, and networking within a region
Separate Azure subscriptions used to isolate billing and access permissions
questions.explanation: Availability zones are physically separate groups of datacenters within an Azure region, each designed with independent power, cooling, and networking. Deploying supported resources across zones can improve resilience against datacenter-level failures. Availability zones are different from Azure regions, which represent separate geographic locations.
questions.subtopic: Describe the core architectural components of Azure
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe the core architectural components of Azure — Availability zones

questions.stem: A company runs an application on multiple identical Azure virtual machines. It wants Azure to automatically increase or decrease the number of virtual machine instances according to CPU utilization. Which service should the company use?
questions.explanation: Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets enable organizations to deploy and manage groups of similar virtual machines. Scale sets support automatic scaling based on metrics such as CPU utilization. Azure Virtual Desktop delivers virtual desktops and applications, while Dedicated Host provides dedicated physical hosting.
questions.subtopic: Describe Azure compute and networking services
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe Azure compute and networking services — Virtual Machine Scale Sets

questions.stem: A development team needs to deploy a web application to Azure. The team wants Microsoft to manage the underlying operating system, web hosting infrastructure, and platform maintenance while developers manage the application code. Which Azure service is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: Azure App Service is a managed platform for hosting web applications and APIs. It allows developers to focus on application code while Microsoft manages the underlying hosting platform and operating system maintenance. Azure Virtual Machines would require the customer to manage the guest operating system.
questions.subtopic: Describe Azure compute and networking services
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe Azure compute and networking services — Application hosting

questions.stem: A company has an Azure ExpressRoute circuit connecting its on-premises datacenter to an Azure virtual network. It now wants to access an Azure Storage account through a private IP address within that virtual network instead of using the storage account's public endpoint. Which Azure feature should it configure?
questions.explanation: Azure Private Endpoint provides a private IP address within a virtual network for accessing supported Azure services, including Azure Storage. When properly configured with networking and DNS, the storage service can be accessed privately from on-premises through ExpressRoute. ExpressRoute provides private network connectivity, while Private Endpoint provides private access to the specific service.
questions.subtopic: Describe Azure compute and networking services
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe Azure compute and networking services — Public and private endpoints

questions.stem: A company is evaluating Azure Blob Storage for several workloads. Which TWO requirements are appropriate uses of Azure Blob Storage? Choose TWO.
options: Storing user-uploaded image files as unstructured objects
Providing managed SMB file shares to office computers
Archiving application log files as unstructured objects
Attaching persistent operating system disks to Azure virtual machines
questions.explanation: Azure Blob Storage is an object storage service designed for large quantities of unstructured data, such as images, documents, and log files. Azure Files is designed for managed file shares, including SMB access. Azure managed disks provide persistent block storage for virtual machines.
questions.subtopic: Describe Azure storage services
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe Azure storage services — Compare Azure Storage services

questions.stem: A company wants employees in its finance department to have read access to a specific Azure Storage account. It also requires users signing in from outside trusted locations to complete multifactor authentication. Which combination of controls best addresses these two requirements?
options: Microsoft Entra ID and Azure Policy
Azure RBAC and Azure resource locks
Azure RBAC and Microsoft Entra Conditional Access
questions.explanation: Azure role-based access control (RBAC) determines what actions users can perform on Azure resources and at which scope. Microsoft Entra Conditional Access evaluates sign-in conditions, including location signals, and can require multifactor authentication. Together, they address resource authorization and context-based authentication requirements.
questions.subtopic: Describe Azure identity, access, and security
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe Azure identity, access, and security — RBAC and Conditional Access

questions.stem: An organization must migrate 200 TB of data from its on-premises datacenter to Azure Storage. Its internet connection is too slow to complete the transfer within the required timeframe. Which Azure service allows the organization to transfer the data by shipping a physical appliance?
questions.explanation: Azure Data Box provides physical devices that organizations can use to transfer large quantities of data to Azure. Data is copied to the device locally, and the device is shipped to Microsoft for ingestion into Azure Storage. This approach can be useful when transferring data over the available network would take too long.
questions.subtopic: Describe Azure storage services
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe Azure storage services — Migration options and Azure Data Box

questions.stem: A company has Azure resources used by its marketing, finance, and operations departments. The finance team wants to categorize resources by department so it can analyze Azure spending by department. Which Azure feature should it use?
questions.explanation: Azure resource tags are name-value pairs that help organizations categorize resources according to attributes such as department, project, or cost center. Cost analysis tools can use tags to group and report spending. Tags do not directly restrict resource usage or enforce spending limits.
questions.subtopic: Describe cost management in Azure
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe cost management in Azure — Purpose of tags

questions.stem: An organization requires newly deployed Azure resources to be located only in two approved Azure regions. Administrators want the restriction to be evaluated automatically when resources are created. Which Azure service should they use?
questions.explanation: Azure Policy evaluates resources against organizational rules and can deny deployments that do not meet specified requirements. An allowed-locations policy can restrict resource deployment to approved regions. Azure RBAC controls permissions, while resource locks protect resources against specified management operations.
questions.subtopic: Describe features and tools in Azure for governance and compliance
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe features and tools for governance and compliance — Azure Policy

questions.stem: An administrator wants to protect an Azure resource group and its existing resources against accidental deletion while continuing to allow authorized users to modify resource configurations. Which Azure resource lock level should the administrator apply?
questions.explanation: A CanNotDelete lock prevents deletion of protected resources while permitting authorized modifications that do not require deleting them. A ReadOnly lock is more restrictive because it blocks updates as well as deletion operations. Resource locks apply at the management plane and are separate from Azure RBAC role assignments.
questions.subtopic: Describe features and tools in Azure for governance and compliance
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe features and tools for governance and compliance — Resource locks

questions.stem: A team deploys Azure resources using a JSON Azure Resource Manager (ARM) template. The team later redeploys the template to the same resource group using incremental deployment mode. Which TWO statements correctly describe the deployment behavior? Choose TWO.
options: Existing resources omitted from the template are automatically deleted from the resource group
Resources declared in the template are created or updated according to the template configuration
Existing resources not declared in the template remain in the resource group
Every deployment creates a new Azure subscription for the declared resources
questions.explanation: ARM templates declaratively specify the desired configuration of Azure resources. In incremental deployment mode, resources defined in the template are created or updated, while existing resources omitted from the template are not deleted merely because they are absent. This differs from approaches that explicitly remove resources no longer included in a deployment definition.
questions.subtopic: Describe features and tools for managing and deploying Azure resources
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe features and tools for managing and deploying Azure resources — ARM templates

questions.stem: A multinational company runs servers in Azure, in its own datacenters, and with another cloud provider. Its administrators want to bring supported servers outside Azure under a consistent Azure-based management and governance approach. Which service should they use?
questions.explanation: Azure Arc extends Azure management and governance capabilities to supported resources outside Azure, including on-premises servers and resources in other cloud environments. Administrators can use Azure tools and services to manage these hybrid and multicloud resources. Azure Migrate focuses on migration, while Azure Data Box handles large-scale data transfers.
questions.subtopic: Describe features and tools for managing and deploying Azure resources
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe features and tools for managing and deploying Azure resources — Azure Arc

questions.stem: An IT operations team wants to receive notifications about Azure service incidents and planned maintenance events that could affect the Azure services and regions used by its organization. Which Azure service should it use?
questions.explanation: Azure Service Health provides personalized information about Azure service issues, planned maintenance, and health advisories relevant to an organization's Azure resources. It also supports alerts for events that may affect subscribed services and regions. Azure Advisor instead provides recommendations for improving Azure workloads.
questions.subtopic: Describe monitoring tools in Azure
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe monitoring tools in Azure — Azure Service Health

questions.stem: A development team wants to monitor a web application's request rates, response times, failures, and dependencies. The team also needs to run Kusto Query Language (KQL) queries against collected log data to investigate problems. Which TWO Azure Monitor capabilities directly support these requirements? Choose TWO.
options: Azure Advisor for workload optimization recommendations
Application Insights for application performance telemetry
Azure Service Health for platform incident notifications
Log Analytics for querying collected monitoring logs
questions.explanation: Application Insights provides application performance monitoring, including telemetry about requests, dependencies, failures, and response times. Log Analytics enables analysis of collected log data by using Kusto Query Language. Azure Advisor provides optimization recommendations, and Azure Service Health reports Azure platform issues rather than detailed application telemetry.
questions.subtopic: Describe monitoring tools in Azure
questions.source: Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide: Describe monitoring tools in Azure — Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights
